category: 小型电动越野车 / 小电摩 / 入门拉新车型
positioning: 高配低价，用来拉新引流；重点让用户觉得同价位配置更高、能多玩一会、起步更猛。
required_copy_rule: 只写真实配置；不确定的价格、续航或竞品数据写成待补充。核心不要泛泛写电摩，要围绕 M5S 小车高配低价、三星电池、27Ah 大容量、强动力和多玩半小时。

specs.battery_advantage: 比常见 20Ah 对手多 7Ah 容量
specs.play_time_advantage: 同场景下可多玩约半小时
specs.rear_suspension: ZN06 260mm Adjustable air suspension shock absorber
specs.brake_system: Hydraulic front and rear disc brakes

copy_angles_cn: 高配低价的小车，先用价格感和配置反差拉住用户。
M5S 用 48V 27Ah 三星电池，不是普通小容量电池。
比常见 20Ah 对手多 7Ah 容量，重点说能多玩一会。
同场景下大约多玩半小时，别只讲参数，要讲多出来的快乐时间。
2600W 48V 动力，起步提速要拍出猛和直接。
液压前后碟刹，动力强也要让用户看到刹得住。
前后越野减震和大小轮配置，拍出小车也能玩得野。
LED 500Lux 前灯，补一个夜景或车库灯光镜头。
710mm 座高和小车身，强调新手更容易上手。
最后回到拉新引流：同预算买更高配置，M5S 更适合作为第一台小电摩。
copy_angles_en: A high-spec mini e-moto at an entry-friendly price.
M5S uses a 48V 27Ah Samsung-cell lithium battery.
That is 7Ah more capacity than many 20Ah competitors.
More battery means roughly half an hour more fun in the same riding scenario.
The 2600W 48V setup should feel punchy off the line.
Hydraulic front and rear disc brakes help keep that power under control.
Off-road suspension and mixed wheel sizes make this small bike feel ready to play.
The LED 500Lux light deserves a dedicated detail shot.
The 710mm seat height makes the bike feel more approachable for new riders.
For the same budget, M5S is built to feel like more bike for the money.
selling_points: 比常见 20Ah 对手多 7Ah 容量

M7S.category: 高性能电动越野车 / 大车 / 强动力车型
M7S.positioning: M7S 是更强动力、更大尺寸、更高速度的大车，用来承接进阶用户和高性能需求。

specs.rear_suspension: ZN06 260mm Adjustable air suspension shock absorber
specs.brake_system: Hydraulic front and rear disc brakes

copy_angles_cn: M7S 是更强动力的大车，重点拍 5500W 60V 的压迫感。
60V 27Ah 电池，适合强调更强性能和更长骑行空间。
50Mph 最高速度，动态镜头要拍出速度感。
45/48mm 700mm 倒置越野前叉，拍出大车越野配置。
260mm 可调空气后减震，适合做跳动、压缩、通过性镜头。
液压前后碟刹，强动力也要强调刹车控制。
800mm 座高和更大车身，定位更适合进阶玩家。
30Miles 续航，适合表达更长路线和更远探索。
M7S 适合做性能展示、越野测试、速度冲击和高阶玩家内容。
copy_angles_en: M7S is the bigger, stronger bike built around 5500W 60V performance.
The 60V 27Ah battery supports a stronger, longer ride.
Use motion shots to show the 50Mph performance feel.
The larger 70/100-17 front and 90/100-14 rear tires make it look more aggressive.
The 45/48mm 700mm inverted off-road fork deserves a dedicated detail shot.
Show the 260mm adjustable air rear suspension under compression.
Hydraulic front and rear disc brakes help control the stronger power.
The 800mm seat height and larger body fit more advanced riders.
30 miles of range supports longer routes and deeper exploration.
M7S is best for performance demos, off-road tests, speed impact, and advanced rider content.
selling_points_en: hydraulic front and rear disc brakes
roughly half an hour more riding time
hydraulic front and rear disc brakes
compact body that is easier to start with
